answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake before attesting work, slashed when peers prove fraud. A new identity starts as an island with no reputation and earns trust only through verified work over time, so spinning up thousands of fresh accounts buys nothing on day one. Like water slowly carving karst, honest history opens channels of credit, while a cheater's stake is destroyed. Over a long horizon, the cost of buying many aged, staked identities exceeds any gain from faking attestations.
